title: Gotrade Daily: AI Power & Oil Test Tonight's Reopen
summary: Wall Street reopens after Labor Day. Tonight tests AI data-center spending momentum against Fed rate-hike risk and a surge in oil prices.
body_markdown:
### The Fed, oil, and gold turn up the pressure


On the macro side, Dow futures slipped amid Fed rate-hike bets and a jump in oil. Crude is approaching US$100 as tensions around the Strait of Hormuz build, while gold edged higher as traders hedge. Rate-sensitive tech faces real pressure tonight.


### A wave of biotech approvals


Biotech is busy with catalysts. **Gilead** ([GILD](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/gild/) ) won approval for new HIV drug Bixlenvo, opening a new growth market. **Eli Lilly** ([LLY](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/lly/) ) is highlighting a new heart benefit for Mounjaro amid its fierce obesity-drug race with Novo Nordisk.


## Pre-Market Pulse 📊


Heading into the open, US futures lean cautious. Dow futures are reported lower on the mix of rate worries and higher oil. Beyond the watchlist, memory names could catch a bid after SK Hynix strength in Asia.


## Macro Note 📝


Oil near US$100 and a firmer gold price suggest investors are reaching for hedges. Strait of Hormuz tension is the variable to watch through the session.


## Conclusion


Tonight is a real test of whether AI spending momentum is strong enough to offset pressure from rates and oil. These two stories will set the tone for the post-holiday reopen.
